caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal plaque with two circular holes near the left and right edges, positioned symmetrically opposite each other. The surface of the plaque features a raised relief image of a wheeled vehicle with two spoked wheels, a central body, and an upright rectangular structure at the center. At the top of the upright structure, there appears to be a small object that resembles a bird or decorative element. To the left of the structure, there is an angled, ladder-like form extending outward and downward, while the right side features additional curved and angular elements sprouting from the main body, suggesting mechanical or structural details. The overall coloration of the plaque is gray with dark shading and lighter highlights that emphasize the three-dimensional texture of the relief. The composition is framed by a raised border running along the inner edge of the plaque, and there is a small inscription or signature near the bottom right corner that reads "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE."
title: Firemark
